formal_statement: ∀ (q N : ℕ) (I : Fin N → Fin N → Prop) [DecidableRel I] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), 2 ≤ q → N = q ^ 2 + q + 1 → (∀ l : Fin N, (Finset.univ.filter (fun p => I p l)).card = q + 1) → (∀ p1 p2 : Fin N, p1 ≠ p2 → ∃! l1 : Fin N, I p1 l1 ∧ I p2 l1) → PEqualNP.ReadK.AndOrFanInTwo C → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N + N) C → (∀ z : Fin (N + N) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) C z = decide (∃ p3 l3 : Fin N, I p3 l3 ∧ z (Fin.castAdd N p3) = true ∧ z (Fin.natAdd N l3) = true)) → PEqualNP.ReadK.IsSingleRead C (N + N) (fun w => decide (N ≤ w)) ((List.finRange N).flatMap (fun p5 => ((List.finRange N).filter (fun l5 => decide (I p5 l5))).map (fun l6 => (p5.val, N + l6.val)))) → N * q ≤ 32 * C.size + 3 * N
plain_statement: A plane of order q >= 2: N = q^2+q+1 points and lines, q+1 points on each line, two distinct points on exactly one line; inputs x_p (points), then y_l (lines). C has AND and OR gates of fan-in at most two, each reading earlier wires, and computes incidence (true when some point and a line through it are both true). C is single-read: each incident pair p, l has a proof tree (all inputs at an AND, one at an OR) with leaves among x_p, y_l and y_l once, or one with x_p once. Then N q <= 32 times the gates of C plus 3N.
title: Plane of order q: AND/OR circuits of fan-in at most two computing incidence with no doubly re-read incidence have at least N(q - 3)/32 gates
